items.name: Robot-ASL-Tutor
items.description: We built a robotic hand that helps tutor deaf children in American Sign Language through a quiz format. The deaf learners are tasked to translate signed letters into English letters, and manually sign letters into English words into a AI vision model. The CNN was programmed in python and sends data to a Raspberry Pi Pico to control the hand.
